title: Electric field magnitude
description: Essential: Correctly states the final answer for part (1) as E = √3 mg / q.

title: Ball B charge
description: Essential: Correctly states the final answer for part (2) as Q = 2mgR² / (kq).

title: Force balance at point a
description: Important: Applies static equilibrium to ball A at point a, relating electric force, gravity, and normal force (or using geometry to find tan 60°).

title: Coulomb's law application
description: Important: Uses Coulomb's law correctly to express the force between balls A and B in terms of their charges and distance R.

title: Force balance at point b
description: Important: Applies static equilibrium to ball B at point b, relating the Coulomb force component, gravity, and possibly normal force.

title: Geometry and angle identification
description: Important: Correctly identifies the 60° angle from the geometry of the circle (e.g., relating height R/2 to radius R).

title: Unit consistency
description: Optional: Explicitly includes or checks units in the final answers (N/C for E, C for Q).

title: Sign or direction error
description: Pitfall: Makes an error with the sign/direction of forces (e.g., electric force on A, component of Coulomb force on B) leading to incorrect equations.

title: Incorrect distance or angle
description: Pitfall: Uses an incorrect distance between charges (not R) or misidentifies the angle (not 60°) for force components.
